# Security Requirements Quality Checklist: Platform Foundation

**Purpose**: Gate 2 review of how well the security, secrets and ledger-integrity requirements are written (identity and sessions, secret handling, database identities, ledger immutability, deny-by-default)
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Identity and Sessions

- [ ] CHK001 Are the operations of the identity interface (sign in, current person, roles, sign out) and their failure outcomes fully specified, so an OIDC adapter can meet the same contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, contracts/identity-provider.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the requirement that unknown accounts, wrong passwords and placeholder credentials give an identical response stated for both the message and the status? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK003 Is session expiry defined with a default value and a bounded range, and is it consistent between the spec assumption (8 h) and the settings contract? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, contracts/settings.md]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec state what sign-out guarantees, given that the plan's revocation is lost on API restart (research R-05)? Is that limitation written as an accepted requirement or left only in research? [Conflict, Spec §FR-017, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements for repeated failed sign-in attempts (lockout, delay or explicit exclusion for the MVP) documented? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the rule for when role changes in the account file take effect for existing sessions specified? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the minimum strength of a demo account credential defined, or explicitly left to the operator? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK008 Are audit requirements defined for sign-out and session refusal events, not only sign-in attempts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]

## Secret Handling

- [ ] CHK009 Is "secret setting" defined with a complete list, so FR-015's "never printed" rule can be checked per setting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, contracts/settings.md]
- [ ] CHK010 Are all output channels where a secret could leak (logs, error messages, traces, health output, CLI output, container environment listings) listed in the requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it specified whether request headers carrying session tokens may appear in traces or logs? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the scope of the secret scan (working tree only, or also git history) and its allowed exceptions (documented placeholders) defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements for rotating the session-signing secret, and its effect on live sessions, stated or explicitly deferred? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the handling of the database superuser credential (who holds it, where it lives, that no platform service uses it) stated in the spec rather than only in the plan? [Gap, data-model.md §Database identities]
- [ ] CHK015 Are file-permission or read-only-mount requirements for the account file stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]

## Database Identities and Ledger Immutability

- [ ] CHK016 Are the rights of each data store identity (schema owner, application) listed per data area, so least privilege can be reviewed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "refused by the data store" defined precisely enough (an error raised, not changes silently ignored) to tell a correct implementation from a no-op one? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the immutability requirement cover bulk removal of all rows (truncate) as well as row update and delete? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the residual risk that a data store superuser can bypass immutability documented as an accepted assumption with its target-state mitigation? [Assumption, research.md R-03]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements consistent between "every identity is refused" (FR-011) and "reset and full rollback remove ledger data" (edge cases), with the allowed path named exactly? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the content-hash format of the baseline ledger record specified in the requirements, or only in the data model? [Traceability, Spec §FR-009, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK022 Is it stated whether this feature must check the previous-record-hash chain, or only store it for feature 005? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a failed or partial migration (what state the store is left in, and how it is recovered)? [Gap, Recovery]

## Deny-by-Default and Access Control

- [ ] CHK024 Is the deny-by-default rule written so that endpoints added by later features are protected unless explicitly exempted, rather than listing today's endpoints only? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the list of unauthenticated endpoints closed and explicit (health check, sign-in), and is the information the health check may reveal limited? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK026 Are transport security requirements (encryption in transit for the API and the data store) stated for `dev` and `demo`, or explicitly deferred? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Is it specified who may run reset and full rollback, and whether they are allowed on `demo` at all? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the role catalogue's integrity (who may change it, and that runtime only reads it) addressed? [Assumption, Spec §FR-019]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK029 Can SC-008 ("zero secret values appear in logs") be measured objectively, with the inspected outputs and secret values named? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK030 Does SC-004 cover both identities and all three mutation types (update, delete, truncate)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the security acceptance scenarios traceable to each security requirement (FR-011, FR-014 to FR-021)? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
